[b][u]Nordiheim Military Developments[/u][/b][i](joust some rp stuff to make future ideas more legitimate :P )[/i]

The Minister of war have declared that the Nordiheimian navy are to undergo a expansion effort of its fleets that most likely will take 5 to 6 years, this is after long discusions between him and the rest of the Nordiheimian admiralty and higher officers came to the conclusion that they lack sufficient numbers of ships to be able to protect the shiping lanes inn the Argos and Shamat straits while also dealing with the potential need to protect the growing amount of new trade routes.

It was also decided to work towards the decomision of the 3 battleships still in service, as the cost and use of them can no longer realy be justified no matter how many point defence and missiles that can theoreticaly be mounted on them, they are simply to old and require expensive upgrades and maintenance that can be easely used for the commision of new Tyr-Class cruisers to replace them.
It have been decided to keep one of the battleships though, after its decomision it will be restored to its 40s configuration and use it as a floating museum about the conflicts that it, and the other ships of its class, took part inn.

The military R&D department of Nordiheims naval branch is also tasked with creating new types of ship designs with the main task of countering the different types of air treaths that are only increasing in the modern battlefield such as faster and more agile missiles, rockets, drones and stealth features, while still being a treath to more conventional aircraft and naval ships, someting that will not be an easy task as some "prediction" might be needed.
Some other qualities that is seen as desired is a small size, high speed & manuverability and a small radar cross section.
Many private nordiheimian entities within the buisiness of making and designing naval assets are allso being involved in this task to help come up with new and inovating ideas for the ships of the future.

[u]FARV- 40 Kakapo[/u]
The joint venture between AIS-Corp. and the Lavian Makinar Armor Workshop going forward with a "design" having been more or less decided on, aswell as what parts the two companies will have as their main duty, with AIS-Corp. focusing on the advanced sensors and the turret design while MAW is coming up with the best hull, engine and suspension design.
The vehicle will be a somewhat compact design with 6 wheels that will have advanced sensors able to detect and track targets on the ground and in the air regardless off wether they are moving or static.
It will also be equiped with a rapid fire CG-40 T3A (40mm) cannon as its main weapon, with a gun system that will be designed to keep it stabilized and able to be used with good effect ageinst air targets such as helicopters and drones, AIS-Corp. have said that they are asigning their best people to this jobb to ensure that the desired outcome becomes reality. 
There have also been mentioned by both nations (Nordiheim and [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]) that a high speed and good agility is desired for the vehicle in adition to a good ability to traverse more difficult terain, MAW sees this desire as well within their engineers ability to provide as this is a prerequisite that they have faced and overcome before.

[u]New version for the Platypus 1B[/u]
The Karlson Company and Steel Boats Inc. cooperation to create a turret that can be used on the Platypus 1B chassie is also coming allong nicely for the most part, the one ting that seem to need the most work on their proposed turret is the ability to use a 120mm cannon in it, though they have expresed confidence that they will solve all problems that could apear, they are now working close with the state owned cannon manufactory (Nordiheim Arms) to make a recoil mechanism and reloading system that will allow their turret to function as they have promissed.
If they are fully successfull it will allow the Platypus vehicle to potentialy function in a "Tank destroyer" and even a "Fire support" role.
